subject: E-Commerce
title: India's Flipkart Story
description: A quick, practical guide to India's Flipkart Story.

hook.text: Flipkart started selling books in 2007 from a two-bedroom apartment in Bangalore. Walmart bought it for $16B.

buildup.text: India's e-commerce faced unique challenges: poor addresses, cash-based economy, and unreliable delivery.

discovery.text: Flipkart pioneered cash-on-delivery in India. Customers paid cash to the delivery person. Trust solved.

twist.text: Amazon entered India in 2013 and invested $10 billion to compete. The market became a two-horse race.

climax.text: India's e-commerce solutions—COD, hyperlocal delivery—are now exported to other emerging markets.

punchline.text: Two-bedroom apartment to $16B sale. Cash-on-delivery cracked India.

quiz.question: What innovation helped Flipkart succeed in India?
options: Cash-on-delivery for customers without credit cards
